params.name: run_id
params.description: Filter by a specific run ID.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the agent associated with the run.

params.name: agent_ids
params.description: The unique identifiers of the agents associated with the run. Deprecated in favor of agent_id field.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filter runs by status. Can specify multiple statuses.

params.name: background
params.description: If True, filters for runs that were created in background mode.

params.name: stop_reason
params.description: Filter runs by stop reason.

params.name: template_family
params.description: Filter runs by template family (base_template_id).

params.name: step_count
params.description: Filter runs by step count. Must be provided with step_count_operator.

params.name: step_count_operator
params.description: Operator for step_count filter: 'eq' for equals, 'gte' for greater than or equal, 'lte' for less than or equal.

params.name: tools_used
params.description: Filter runs that used any of the specified tools.

params.name: before
params.description: Run ID cursor for pagination. Returns runs that come before this run ID in the specified sort order

params.name: after
params.description: Run ID cursor for pagination. Returns runs that come after this run ID in the specified sort order

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of runs to return

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for runs by creation time. 'asc' for oldest first, 'desc' for newest first

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field to sort by

params.name: active
params.description: Filter for active runs.

params.name: ascending
params.description: Whether to sort agents oldest to newest (True) or newest to oldest (False, default). Deprecated in favor of order field.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Filter runs by project ID.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Filter runs by conversation ID.

params.name: duration_percentile
params.description: Filter runs by duration percentile (1-100). Returns runs slower than this percentile.

params.name: duration_value
params.description: Duration value in nanoseconds for filtering. Must be used with duration_operator.

params.name: duration_operator
params.description: Comparison operator for duration filter: 'gt' (greater than), 'lt' (less than), 'eq' (equals).

params.name: start_date
params.description: Filter runs created on or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: end_date
params.description: Filter runs created on or before this date (ISO 8601 format).
